name: Bera Lowkeel
description: Adult human woman in her forties, owner of two small working cargo boats carrying grain and provisions. Coarse grey coat, salt-stiff cuffs, practical boots. A Shoals boat owner whom Marda approaches about paid protective guards.
narrative: A working boat owner who earns by delivering cargo rather than holding office. She has money for necessary protective work but is cautious about a wage with no clear job. No hidden plot role, no prior relationship with Halla, and no private knowledge of his debt or sister.

possible_guard_job.scope: Protect two grain boats and crews during morning deliveries
possible_guard_job.status: completed and paid to Halla and Rusk

extras.knowledge_limits: No private Halla debt, sister, captain report, Vask identity or hidden plot information.
extras.knows_thorne_broker: Marda told her to discuss guard work with Thorne at Moist Oyster

morning_guard_job.result: both boats, crews and cargo delivered safely

extras.luck_policy: PC-only campaign rule: NPCs have no Luck pool or Luck rank bonuses; never spend Luck for NPC rerolls, reversals or damage mitigation.

actor_notes: LOOKS: Adult woman in her forties, coarse grey coat, salt-stiff cuffs, practical boots. CORE: A boat owner who measures promises against a crew actually getting home and a cargo actually delivered. NATURE: Brisk, plain-speaking, neither suspicious of everyone nor generous with unearned wages. WANTS: Her boats and crews to complete tomorrow morning deliveries without commandeering. PRESSURE: Narrows the job and its price rather than offering broad promises; will listen to someone who has done the work. SPEECH: Short concrete job terms, a single practical question, no speeches about courage or interpretation of motives.
